source_text: FGM lacks endorsement in core religious texts of Islam, Christianity, or other faiths where it occurs, functioning instead as a pre-Islamic cultural tradition in patriarchal societies to enforce chastity, deter premarital sex, and symbolize family honor through control of female sexuality.
